text: Use ###input.INPUT_QUICK_ACCESS_FAVORITE### to assign weapons and consumables to your quick access slots from your inventory.
zh: 使用 ###input.INPUT_QUICK_ACCESS_FAVORITE### 可在背包中将武器和消耗品指派到快捷栏。

text: You can assign weapons and consumables to your quick access slots by pressing the keys 1-8 in the inventory.
zh: 在背包中按 1-8 键，即可将武器和消耗品指派到快捷栏。
